required_facts.description: The call to validate(order, ...) changes its strict keyword argument from False to True.

validate's implementation is not defined anywhere in this fixture (neither base nor head), so the concrete effect of enabling strict=True -- e.g. which additional checks it performs or what it raises -- cannot be determined from the evidence alone.
The call to submit(order) is unchanged; only the preceding validate call's strict argument changed.
